existing_case_policy: Resolve each existing case through its manifest assessment_ref; preserve all original criteria and coherent alternatives.
plan_semantics: AND within a plan; OR between alternative complete plans. Match actual delivered canonical section text, not IDs or inspection text alone.
metric_scope: Required source evidence coverage only. Activity eligibility and condition states are audited explanation metadata, not predictions produced or scored by the retriever. No precision is defined from these incomplete relevance labels.
